import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz';
+
+def write_project(name, source):
+    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
+    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
+        [package]
+        name="{name}"
+        version="0.1.0"
+
+        [[target.bin]]
+        name="{name}"
+        path="src/main.fzy"
+    '''))
+    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
+    return root
+
+def verify(name, source):
+    root = write_project(name, source)
+    proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'verify', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
+    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
+    assert proc.returncode == 0, (name, proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
+    assert payload['errors'] == 0, payload
+    return root
+
+def read_json(path):
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+artifact_root = verify('runtime_handle_artifacts', '''
+    use core.http;
+    use core.proc;
+    use core.thread;
+
+    fn worker() -> i32 {
+        return 7
+    }
+
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let listener = http.bind()
+        defer close(listener)
+        let conn = http.accept()
+        let ws = http.websocket_accept(conn)
+        discard http.websocket_close(ws, 1000, "ok")
+
+        let argv = proc.argv_new()
+        let env = proc.env_new()
+        let proc_handle = proc.spawn_cmd("echo", argv, env, "")
+        discard proc.close(proc_handle)
+
+        let handle = spawn(worker)
+        discard join(handle)
+        return 0
+    }
+''')
+
+memory_report = read_json(artifact_root / '.fz' / 'memory-report.json')
+memory_report_text = json.dumps(memory_report)
+assert 'listener' in memory_report_text and 'HttpHandle' in memory_report_text, memory_report
+assert 'ws' in memory_report_text and 'WebSocketHandle' in memory_report_text, memory_report
+assert 'proc_handle' in memory_report_text and 'ProcessHandle' in memory_report_text, memory_report
+assert 'argv' in memory_report_text and 'ProcessArgv' in memory_report_text, memory_report
+assert 'env' in memory_report_text and 'ProcessEnv' in memory_report_text, memory_report
+assert 'handle' in memory_report_text and 'TaskHandle' in memory_report_text, memory_report
+
+runtime_contracts = read_json(artifact_root / '.fz' / 'native-runtime-contracts.json')
+contracts_text = json.dumps(runtime_contracts)
+assert 'http.websocket_close' in contracts_text, runtime_contracts
+assert 'consume_arg0_borrow_close_payload' in contracts_text, runtime_contracts
+assert 'proc.close' in contracts_text and 'consume_arg0' in contracts_text, runtime_contracts
+assert 'join' in contracts_text and 'consumes_linear_handle' in contracts_text, runtime_contracts
+
+print('compiler-memory-artifact-runtime-handles-ok')
